cards.words_note: Typed words match photo 1 (ZIONATION list) and photo 3 (CATCH A STRAY). Small differences in the list: the sheet numbers Kayfabe as 1, the typed list starts its numbers at 'I see cameras'; 'one step higher' typed as 'step higher'; 'Noble place hate' typed as 'Noble place bet'. SONG 14 appears only as the cut-off line starts seen at the edge of photo 1, but photo 7 shows the full song. Photos 4, 6, 7, 8, 9 (Point My Finger, Song 14, the Zionation slips) could not be confirmed because the typed text is cut at 1800 chars. The BI ALBUM / sexy dirty lyrics sheets in photos 2 and 10-21 are not in the typed words; they belong to another piece.
cards.name_note: ZIONATION is the title written at the top of the handwritten list in photo 1.
cards.other_problems: Photos 2 and 10-21 show the BI ALBUM / 'Highlighter - sexy dirty lyrics' sheets, a different piece. Photo 2 blocks read 1-7-3-1-2 and photo 22 blocks read 1-7-3-2 (item 1732), so photos 2, 10-22 most likely belong on 1732, not 1731. Photo 22 is a wide shot of that 1732 spread. The turned 'UPRIGHT' copies for photos 2, 6, 8, 20 and 22 are sideways, but their original website files open the right way up when read here, so the turn made them worse; keep the originals. Photo 5 is too blurry to read. Photos 11 and 12 are soft/blurry. Photos 9 and 17 show loose stray number blocks from other items (6, 9/6, 6, 0 and 6, 5, 0) lying at the edges.
